repo.description:
## Impact

The responses of following API paths are not properly audit logged under certain conditions:

- `sys/generate-root/attempt`
- `sys/generate-root/update`
- `sys/rekey/init`
- `sys/rekey/update`
- `sys/rekey/verify`
- `sys/rekey-recovery-key/init`
- `sys/rekey-recovery-key/update`
- `sys/rekey-recovery-key/verify`

There are some factors that limit the impact:

- Since OpenBao 2.5.3, all affected paths are unavailable by default and only accessible if explicitly enabled via `disable_unauthed_rekey_endpoints = false` or `disable_unauthed_generate_root_endpoints = false` in the OpenBao config. 

- The requests audit log entry is still generated, just the response entry will me missing.

- The audit log has to succeed for logging the request, but fail for the response. 

## Patch

This vulnerability is patched in OpenBao v2.7.1 and v2.6.4.

### Workarounds

If you run OpenBao 2.5.3 or higher: Make sure `disable_unauthed_rekey_endpoints` and `disable_unauthed_generate_root_endpoints` are set to `true` (which is the default value). If you ever need them, you can temporarily change the config.

## References

- [`disable_unauthed_generate_root_endpoints`](https://openbao.org/docs/configuration/listener/tcp/#:~:text=disable%5Funauthed%5Fgenerate%5Froot%5Fendpoints)
- [`disable_unauthed_rekey_endpoints`](https://openbao.org/docs/configuration/listener/tcp/#:~:text=disable%5Funauthed%5Frekey%5Fendpoints)
repo.summary: Improper Audit Logging of OpenBao's Root Token Generation and Unauthenticated Rekey Operations
